notes: The first field of each table is its primary field.
Link fields are listed on both sides. The side with createdAutomatically: true is the inverse that Airtable creates by itself when the other side is created through the API.

Every field type here can be created through the Metadata API. Derived numbers (stock, totals, lifetime value) are plain fields written by the automations on purpose: each number has one writer that is tested, and the base needs no formula, rollup or lookup fields to work.

prefersSingleRecordLink: true marks links that should hold one record. The Metadata API cannot set it, so setup/create_base.py creates those links as normal links; switch "Allow linking to multiple records" off by hand if you want the UI to enforce it. The Web API always reads and writes links as arrays of record ids either way.

tables.name: Products
tables.description: Everything Demo Chocolate Co. makes or sells. The SKU matches the Shopify variant SKU.

fields.name: SKU
fields.description: Unique stock keeping unit, same as the Shopify variant SKU. Primary field.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Product name as shown on the shop.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Active products are sold. Draft products were created automatically for an unknown SKU and need a person to check them.

fields.name: Flavor Family
fields.description: Used to balance variety in subscription boxes.

fields.name: Flavor Notes
fields.description: Main flavors. Subscriber dislikes use the same options.

fields.name: May Contain Traces
fields.description: Allergens that may be present from shared equipment.

fields.name: Diet Labels
fields.description: Claims printed on the label. Vegan means no animal ingredients; it can still carry a milk trace warning.

fields.name: Ingredients
fields.description: Full ingredient list from the label.

fields.name: Subscription Eligible
fields.description: Can go into the monthly subscription box.

fields.name: Wholesale Available
fields.description: Offered to wholesale buyers through the Price List.

fields.name: Shopify Product ID
fields.description: gid://shopify/Product/... Empty when the product is not sold on Shopify.

fields.name: Shopify Inventory Item ID
fields.description: gid://shopify/InventoryItem/... Used to set stock in Shopify.

fields.name: Shopify Stock
fields.description: The available quantity Shopify showed after the last inventory sync (sellable minus units in unshipped Shopify orders).

fields.name: Stock Synced At
fields.description: When the inventory sync last pushed this product.

fields.name: Reorder Point
fields.description: Raise a Purchasing Request when sellable stock drops below this.

fields.name: Reorder Quantity
fields.description: Suggested batch size for a Purchasing Request.

fields.name: Daily Capacity
fields.description: Units the kitchen can make per production day.

fields.name: Production Lead Days
fields.description: Days from starting a batch until it can ship (tempering, setting, packing).

fields.name: Needs Review
fields.description: Something about this product needs a person.

fields.name: Box Shipments
fields.description: Subscription boxes that contain this product.

fields.name: Box History
fields.description: Subscription history rows for this product.

fields.name: Promos
fields.description: Short dated promos for this product.

tables.name: Production Batches
tables.description: Source of truth for stock: one row per batch made in the kitchen.

fields.name: Batch Code
fields.description: Printed on the wrapper, for example B-DSS-260815. Primary field.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Released batches can be sold. Planned batches are scheduled. On Hold is waiting for quality control.

fields.name: Produced On
fields.description: Production date. In the future for planned batches.

fields.name: Best Before
fields.description: Best before date printed on the wrapper.

fields.name: Quantity Reserved
fields.description: Units promised to subscription boxes or wholesale orders, not yet shipped.

fields.name: Notes
fields.description: Anything worth knowing about the batch.

fields.name: Box Shipments
fields.description: Subscription boxes packed from this batch.

tables.name: Customers
tables.description: One row per customer. Matched by Shopify Customer ID, then by trimmed lowercase email; updated by record id or created. Never upserted on Email.

fields.name: Email
fields.description: Lowercase email address. Orders are matched on this.

fields.name: Record Status
fields.description: Duplicate rows are kept for history and point to the surviving record in Merged Into.

fields.name: Merged Into
fields.description: For a duplicate: the surviving customer record.

fields.name: Lifetime Value
fields.description: Sum of order totals minus refunds, cancelled orders excluded.

fields.name: Average Order Value
fields.description: Lifetime Value divided by Order Count.

fields.name: VIP Tier
fields.description: Set by the customer stats script from Lifetime Value.

fields.name: Stats Updated At
fields.description: When the customer stats last changed.

tables.name: Orders
tables.description: Shopify orders, upserted by Shopify Order ID from the orders/create and orders/updated webhooks.

fields.name: Order Number
fields.description: Shopify order name, for example #1001. Primary field.

fields.name: Shopify Order ID
fields.description: Numeric Shopify order id. The upsert key.

fields.name: Email
fields.description: Email on the order (used to verify support claims).

fields.name: Shopify Updated At
fields.description: updated_at of the last webhook applied. Older webhooks are ignored.

fields.name: Financial Status
fields.description: From Shopify financial_status (pending, authorized, partially_paid, paid, partially_refunded, refunded, voided). Expired matches the GraphQL displayFinancialStatus EXPIRED.

fields.name: Fulfillment Status
fields.description: From Shopify fulfillment_status (fulfilled, partial, not_eligible, restocked; null means unfulfilled).

fields.name: Shipping City
fields.description: City, used for the melt-risk forecast.

fields.name: Is Gift
fields.description: The buyer marked the order as a gift.

fields.name: Gift Note
fields.description: Message to print on the packing slip.

fields.name: Cold Pack
fields.description: Required when the forecast at the destination reaches MELT_TEMP_C. Review when the forecast could not be checked.

fields.name: Forecast Max C
fields.description: Highest forecast maximum temperature over the melt-risk window, in Celsius.

fields.name: Cold Pack Shipped
fields.description: Ticked by the packing team when a cold pack went in the box.

fields.name: Expected Delivery
fields.description: Delivery date promised by the carrier.

fields.name: Delivered At
fields.description: When the carrier marked it delivered.

fields.name: Needs Review
fields.description: Something about this order needs a person.

tables.name: Order Lines
tables.description: Order line items, upserted by Shopify line item id.

fields.name: Line Item ID
fields.description: Shopify line item id. Primary field and upsert key.

fields.name: SKU Status
fields.description: Matched to a product, unknown SKU, or no SKU on the line.

fields.name: Max Quantity
fields.description: Largest quantity for this tier (inclusive). Empty means no upper limit.

fields.name: Active
fields.description: Only active tiers are used for quotes.

fields.name: Quote Lines
fields.description: Quote lines priced with this tier.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Approved quotes become Shopify draft orders.

fields.name: Processed
fields.description: Ticked once the draft order was created and the invoice sent. Never processed twice.

fields.name: Inquiry ID
fields.description: Id of the form submission. Prevents duplicate quotes.

fields.name: Contact Email
fields.description: Where the quote and the invoice go.

fields.name: Needed By
fields.description: Date the buyer needs the goods.

fields.name: Extraction Method
fields.description: Claude, or the rule-based fallback when Claude was unavailable.

fields.name: Feasibility
fields.description: Can we deliver by the needed-by date?

fields.name: Feasibility Note
fields.description: How the feasibility was worked out.

fields.name: Needs Review
fields.description: A person must check this quote before it is sent.

fields.name: Sent At
fields.description: When the quote email was sent.

fields.name: Email Message ID
fields.description: Message id from the email API.

fields.name: Invoice URL
fields.description: Shopify invoice link sent to the buyer.

fields.name: Processed At
fields.description: When the approved quote was turned into a draft order.

fields.name: Processing Error
fields.description: Last error while creating the draft order.

tables.name: Quote Lines
tables.description: One row per product requested in a quote.

fields.name: Match Status
fields.description: Unmatched lines are flagged for a person.

fields.name: Stock Available
fields.description: Sellable stock when the quote was made.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Only Active subscribers get a box.

fields.name: Dietary Needs
fields.description: Hard requirements. Nut-Free also excludes nut traces.

fields.name: Flavor Dislikes
fields.description: Flavor notes the subscriber does not want.

fields.name: Started On
fields.description: Subscription start date. Longest tenure is served first.

tables.name: Box Shipments
tables.description: One row per subscriber per month.

fields.name: Shipment ID
fields.description: BOX-<month>-<subscriber id>, for example BOX-2026-11-SUB-0001. Primary field and upsert key.

fields.name: Batches
fields.description: Batches the bars were reserved from.

fields.name: Packing List
fields.description: Readable packing list with batch codes.

fields.name: Shortfall Reason
fields.description: Why the box could not be filled.

fields.name: Box History
fields.description: History rows written for this box.

tables.name: Box History
tables.description: Every bar a subscriber received, one row per bar.

fields.name: Box Shipment
fields.description: The box, when it was planned by the curation workflow.

fields.name: Message ID
fields.description: Id of the incoming message. Prevents processing the same message twice.

fields.name: Order Number Given
fields.description: Order number as written by the customer.

fields.name: Email Matches Order
fields.description: The sender email is the email on the order.

fields.name: Classification Method
fields.description: Claude, or keyword fallback when Claude was unavailable.

fields.name: Routing Reason
fields.description: Why the ticket went where it went.

fields.name: Replacement Order Name
fields.description: Shopify order name of the replacement.

fields.name: Reply Sent At
fields.description: When the reply email went out.

fields.name: Reply Message ID
fields.description: Message id from the email API.

fields.name: Action Log
fields.description: Every automated action, one line each, newest last.

tables.name: Promos
tables.description: One promo per short dated batch.

fields.name: Promo Name
fields.description: PROMO-<batch code>. Primary field and upsert key, so a batch never gets two promos.

fields.name: Best Before
fields.description: Best before date of the batch.

fields.name: Units Available
fields.description: Unsold units when the promo was created.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Proposed promos need a person to switch them on in Shopify.

fields.name: Created At
fields.description: When the inventory sync created it.

tables.name: Purchasing Requests
tables.description: Requests to make more of a product. One open request per SKU at a time.

fields.name: SKU
fields.description: Copied so formulas can filter on it.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Open until the kitchen schedules the batch.

fields.name: Sellable Stock
fields.description: Sellable stock when the request was raised.

tables.name: Sync Log
tables.description: One row per automation run, with counts.

fields.name: Run ID
fields.description: Unique run id, for example inventory-2026-10-20T06:00:00Z-48213 (start time plus the n8n execution id). Primary field.

tables.name: Data Quality
tables.description: Findings from the weekly data quality script.

fields.name: Record Name
fields.description: Primary field value of the record.

tables.name: Webhook Log
tables.description: Every webhook delivery received, for deduplication and audit.

fields.name: Event ID
fields.description: X-Shopify-Webhook-Id, or the form submission id. Primary field.
